t1.text: What else should the clipboard do?

n1.text: Concepts, not built. Drawn in the app's real toast style: Mint seed roles, Roboto, the 3 second bar along the foot. Sample values are made up and safe (555 numbers, example addresses). Every idea works offline unless its card says it uses the internet.
